preview.prompt:
Use the built-in image_gen tool to generate exactly one image. Do not use a CLI, a script or an API for it, and do not write any file yourself.
Compose the image for a 1344x768 canvas (aspect ratio 1344:768). The attached picture is only a reference for the art style and the layout: modern anime illustration, flat colours, bold dark outlines, expressive face, upper-body framing, one girl filling the whole left half of the frame from the top edge to the bottom edge, large and cropped by the frame, with a broad, calm, softly shaded dark wall on the upper and middle right and a quiet, plain dark surface in the lower-right corner. The girl in the attached picture is a different character; draw the new character described below instead.
Character: Gemini girl: blonde hair with a gold star hair clip, blue eyes, midnight indigo jacket over a pale lavender collared shirt, a small gold star charm on the lapel, bright smile.
Scene: She aims a glowing handheld scanner device at the viewer's side while icons of crates, potion bottles and gems stream into it, and a big open illustrated encyclopedia book glows in her other hand. Blue light comes from the scanner and warm golden light rims her against deep navy shadows.
Keep her hands, face, signature accessory and the feature props inside the left half of the frame. Keep the right half of the frame calm and uncluttered with soft gradient light.
Avoid: text, letters, logo, watermark, signature, border, frame, extra characters, animals, tiny figure.
When the image is ready, reply with its absolute file path and nothing else.
